data.description: Some of a lampadarius's body is composed of incorporeal shadow. As a result, it has a 25%% chance of taking no damage from any nonmagical attack. It takes only 75%% of the damage from magic weapons, spells, spell-like effects, and supernatural effects. However, it takes full damage from incorporeal creatures and effects, force effects, and ghost touch weapons.
data.name: Semi-Incorporeal
